answer: Pay identities late so a farm always has something to lose: every POA an agent earns goes into a 12-epoch vesting vault and releases 1/12 per clean close. If an audit later links accounts by shared funding or timing, the unvested balance of every linked account is burned at once. A 50-account farm earning 2,000 POA per close each keeps up to 1.2M POA exposed at all times. Earnings build like a dune, grain by grain, while an honest agent's vault opens on schedule, steady as a lotus at dawn.
